items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: We had one of the finest engineers doing that stuff working for us, Roger Seibel in Phoenix, Arizona.

ctx.x: That’s really fascinating. And I’ve always wondered, to do those re-issues, did you have access to master tapes or were you doing disc transfers?

You know everything about Sun Ra and Alton Abraham was chaotic. They both died intestate. Okay? You know now all kinds of masters are showing up. I don’t know much about that but we had difficulty obtaining good masters. We had signed contracts for certain recordings that I selected. And then we would get a box of tapes from, you know, UPS, and it wasn’t necessarily what we had contracted for. And sometimes the masters were not the original masters. Sometimes they were copies of copies. And sometimes the things…
How did you manage to get the Impulse recordings? Did you work with Creed Taylor in the unreleased Impulse sessions?
